fix: restore WID API key as default (public key from official R package)

The key rYFByOB0ioaPATwHtllMI71zLOZSK0Ic5veQonJP is not a secret — it's
embedded in the official WID R package (sysdata.rda) distributed on CRAN
and GitHub (world-inequality-database/wid-r-tool). WID.world does not
offer individual API key registration; this shared key is how all their
official tools authenticate. Restore it as the default fallback with a
clear comment explaining its origin, while still allowing env var override.

build time instead of containing hardcoded values. This makes the data
